title: Vendor size and reputation effects on trust and patronage
statement:
Consumers in an Internet-store experiment recognized differences in vendor size and reputation, and those differences influenced trust, perceived risk, and willingness to patronize, supporting visible real-company evidence for unfamiliar vendors. (DOI)
